answer: Resist sybils by weighting influence with a stake-aged capital bond, not headcount. A fresh key starts near zero and its weight grows only as a locked bond matures like a garden, so cloning a thousand masks just spreads one pool of capital thin and each clone adds a faint ripple. Random audits slash the whole bond on any forged work, and buying real weight means fresh locked collateral an attacker cannot fake, visible on-ledger clear as crystal. Matching N honest agents costs N full bonds held for many epochs.
